function.name: get_macro_def
function.description: Retrieve the definition of a macro, including its line numbers, from the specified source file (.c or .h). The macro_name must be related to src_file: it must be defined, used, or referenced in the specified file. Do not query unrelated macros.

macro_name.description: The name of the macro to retrieve. It must appear in or be referenced by src_file.

src_file.description: The source file where macro_name is defined, used, or referenced.
